owner_decisions.operating_seasons: Hot fall daytime cooling and Christmas heating, including occupied coaches. Owner did not specify year-round peak-summer operation or an exact design temperature.
owner_decisions.boarding: Normal boarding AND unloading from the same physical vehicle side at both stations. Outdoor HVAC section on the opposite side. Left/right and route/turnaround topology remain unassigned.
owner_decisions.accessible_seating: Provide foldable or removable passenger seating in reserved wheelchair bay areas, so the space can carry seated guests when not needed for wheelchair users.
owner_decisions.raised_roof: Owner permits a raised roof section to accommodate the indoor blower above the end doorway. Exact shape/height and framing remain to be coordinated; preserve doorway and service clearance.
owner_decisions.fabrication_allocation: More precise work and finish work will be subcontracted, per owner19October2026. Exact subcontractors, processes and assigned farm/Ralph tasks not yet named.
owner_decisions.engineering_workflow: Codex supports preliminary engineering/design development now. Owner intends to have a qualified engineer review the developed package after the desired design is established.

working_design.regular_count_status: Retained working target; owner questioned changing it. Any proposed change needs a stated fit, comfort, circulation/egress, loading, weight or other demonstrated design reason.
working_design.convertible_seat_preference: Custom fold-up passenger bench/seats with positively retained stowed position; removable assemblies remain an alternative requiring positive retention and designated storage.
working_design.assumption: Interpret owner direction as convertible seating within wheelchair bays. Preserve usable companion seating outside the occupied wheelchair envelope.

modes.notes: Both bay seats deployed; clear aisle and end/side-door approaches remain usable.
Occupied bay seat completely stowed/removed and retained. Evaluate either bay separately and the maneuvering path.
Both bay seats stowed/removed and retained; companion positions and boarding/evacuation route maintained.

capacity_rules: F1/F2 are unresolved passenger places, not adopted seats. Do not assume two additional seats per wheelchair space.
The same bay cannot count deployed passenger seats and a wheelchair simultaneously.
Design/check every mode for circulation, wheelchair maneuvering, companion access, seat loads and attachment/retention; validate actual wheelchair/securement arrangement as applicable.

Check highest passenger/thermal occupancy AND governing mass/CG mode; wheelchair/device/occupant masses and all carried folding hardware count. Existing accessible14thermal-person allowance may need revision after F1/F2 are determined.

Crew converts and inspects before boarding; wheelchair access takes priority when required. No loose chairs or removed benches stored in an aisle, doorway, accessible bay or on an unrestrained platform.
specific_fabrication_work: Dimension each occupied, stowed and intermediate swept envelope from common geometry.
Resolve hinge, stops, service access, pinch protection and positive latches/retention; custom body/floor reinforcement receives loads without blocking route.
Define removable-seat joint/fasteners, handling and restraint/storage if alternative retained.
Specify materials, fits, fasteners/welds and proof/fatigue/inspection criteria from accepted loads and exact mechanism; none sized in this decision record.
outdoor_side_integration: Same physical coach side must meet both station boarding arrangements even after loops/turnarounds/reversing. Normal single-side boarding does not resolve emergency egress, route-side evacuation or eliminate required exits.

sources.limit: Context for review only. Exact attraction/vehicle classification and governing requirements remain unresolved. This section is not cited as explicit approval for a folding-seat mechanism; do not import bus or building dimensions as automatic vehicle requirements.

precision_examples_to_assign: Axle/journal turning, bearing/axlebox bores and specified fits
Wheel/axle and hub joints requiring controlled specialist processes
fabrication_allocation.finish_scope: Finish processes to be scoped by actual body/interior/material choices; no named finisher or capability assumed.
fabrication_allocation.farm_and_Ralph_scope: Assign general fabrication/assembly tasks to demonstrated shop capability and released drawings; no welding qualification, tooling or inspection capability inferred from owner outsourcing decision.
fabrication_allocation.engineer_engagement: Later review intended; no engineer engagement reported. Absence of engagement is not a prerequisite to preliminary design development.
fabrication_allocation.not_changed: Responsible engineering design, controlled component data and actual manufacturing/inspection release requirements remain open.

develop_now: Coordinated custom physical geometry and dimensions
Designer-selected preliminary loads/materials/mechanisms documented with calculations and evidence
Clear exact external interface inputs and later review actions
preliminary_workflow.selection_rule: Make substantiated preliminary project selections rather than leaving every design choice null pending an external engineer. Distinguish designer proposals from verified OEM dimensions/ratings and later professional acceptance.
preliminary_workflow.still_required: Do not invent exact delivered component interfaces, supplier ratings, survey or physical test results. Keep genuinely unavailable mating dimensions explicit and work on independent defined parts. Do not mark construction-approved or commissioned.
preliminary_workflow.next_physical_issue: Accessible coach convertible wheelchair-bay seat layout and custom folding mechanism development; coordinate occupied/stowed/swept envelopes, route and companion access, proposed structure/mounts and configurations from one source. Assess real geometry before assigning additional places. Continue the whole-truck interface work as controlled evidence allows.
